message.content:
This editorial illustration features a light blue background. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is printed in a bold serif font above the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". To the right, a black barcode, a QR code, and publication details include the date "28 FEBRUARI-6 MARET 2022".

Two headlines sit above the central image: "Jalan Terjal Undang-Undang Anti-Kekerasan Seksual H.76" and "Kontroversi Periode Bersiap H.64". Below them, a large-scale illustration dominates the center. A tan, muscular, sweating human arm enters from the bottom left, its hand gripping a black handle that resembles an excavator's bucket. This bucket is attached to an orange mechanical arm of an excavator, which extends from the right. The human arm and the machine arm are positioned as if locked in an arm-wrestling match.

At the bottom, large black text reads "WADAS MELAWAN", followed by four lines of smaller black text starting with "Sejumlah tokoh menjadi motor penolakan..." and ending with "H.26". The overall composition emphasizes the physical tension and struggle between the human and mechanical elements.
